# Halcyon Threshold — Emberfall Rapid Grant proposal (DRAFT, not submitted)

Status: draft for Morgan's review. Items marked [TBD] need Morgan's input before submission. Deadline: 30 November 2026.

## 1. What we will do

Halcyon Threshold is a small, independent effort to improve the odds that the arrival of superintelligent AI goes well for people. We are starting narrow and testing what one person with limited resources can usefully do.

First 6 months (proposed, [TBD] to confirm scope):
- Identify one neglected question in AI safety or governance that is not well covered by existing organisations, and map who is working on it.
- Produce one concrete public-good output on that question, such as a literature map, a small evaluation, or a short analysis.
- Run a small reading group to bring in collaborators and test ideas with other people.
- Publish results openly and track what we learn about where marginal effort helps.

## 2. Why this applicant

- Morgan Hale founded Halcyon Threshold and will be personally accountable for the work and for the funds.
- Morgan has committed evenings and weekends, some personal savings, and writing and Python skills.
- Morgan has been talking with people in the safety community (see the contacts list), which gives early access to collaborators and to neglected questions.
- [TBD] Relevant background or prior work.

## 3. Why this is worth funding

- Superintelligence is among the most consequential transitions in human history, and most of the people working on it are inside a few large labs.
- Small, independent, openly published work can cover gaps that large organisations leave open.
- A small grant lets us test whether this model works before asking for more.

## 4. Budget (draft, [TBD])

| Item | Amount (USD) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Founder time | not requested | Unpaid, evenings and weekends |
| Tools, hosting, domain | [TBD] | Domain renewal $14.99/yr; Pagewell Pro $20/mo if needed for custom domain |
| Reading group and small events | [TBD] | Venue, materials |
| Contractor or research assistance | [TBD] | Only if a clear need emerges |
| Contingency | [TBD] | |
| **Total requested** | **[TBD]** | Grants in this round are typically $5k–$25k |

Note on self-funding: Morgan's notes indicate up to $2,000 of personal savings this year. Confirm whether the proposal should state a matched or self-funded share.

## 5. Risks and how we handle them

- Limited time and capacity: keep the first scope small and check progress at 3 months.
- Working in a neglected area with little feedback: publish early and invite critique.
- Conflicts or outside-role constraints for the applicant: [TBD]. Morgan has an outside-activities disclosure to the employer due 30 Nov 2026 and needs to confirm it is handled before naming any public role.

## 6. Contact

Morgan Hale — morgan@halcyonthreshold.org
